test.test_input: {"narrative":"An adult parkour athlete sprints across a training rooftop, shoes skimming shallow puddles as momentum builds toward a padded obstacle. From a low angle, the athlete plants one foot on a ledge and launches upward, arms driving the body over the gap. A bird's-eye view catches the descent toward a suspended foam pad. The athlete strikes the pad with both feet, bending the knees to absorb the impact while the pad swings away. Carrying the rebound sideways, the athlete rolls behind a low practice wall and settles into stillness. Cut to a close-up of alert eyes peering around the wall; one controlled breath steadies the shoulders while a distant hanging target becomes visible. The athlete retrieves a soft training disc, shifts weight onto the rear foot, and coils the torso. An over-the-shoulder view reveals the final release: the arm snaps forward, the disc streaks across the courtyard, and the target rocks backward from a clean central hit. The athlete follows through, regains balance, and watches the target slowly settle.","frames":["sprint along rooftop toward foam pad","plant foot and launch from ledge","bird's-eye descent toward hanging foam pad","feet strike foam pad, knees bend, pad swings","roll behind low practice wall","ECU eyes peering around wall, hanging target visible","coil torso and draw soft disc back","over-shoulder disc hits target, follow-through"]}

meta_output.narrative: An adult parkour athlete sprints across a training rooftop, shoes skimming shallow puddles as momentum builds toward a padded obstacle. From a low angle, the athlete plants one foot on a ledge and launches upward, arms driving the body over the gap. A bird's-eye view catches the descent toward a suspended foam pad. The athlete strikes the pad with both feet, bending the knees to absorb the impact while the pad swings away. Carrying the rebound sideways, the athlete rolls behind a low practice wall and settles into stillness. Cut to a close-up of alert eyes peering around the wall; one controlled breath steadies the shoulders while a distant hanging target becomes visible. The athlete retrieves a soft training disc, shifts weight onto the rear foot, and coils the torso. An over-the-shoulder view reveals the final release: the arm snaps forward, the disc streaks across the courtyard, and the target rocks backward from a clean central hit. The athlete follows through, regains balance, and watches the target slowly settle.
